purpose: Teach: 異端/卑怯/束縛/醜い/人為/援護/邪悪/監獄

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、宗教史における異端の扱いを論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on how heresy was treated in religious history, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, measured curiosity. Leans slightly forward. Genuinely interested in where he went with the topic. Steady eye contact — the teacher who reads students carefully.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦争中の卑怯な戦法を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on cowardly military tactics during wartime.
lines.style: Quiet, steady response. A slight pause before answering, gathering his thoughts. Precise diction. No apology in his voice, but careful — he knows the weight of what he's examining.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、女性を束縛してきた法律史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You explored how laws have historically constrained women, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slower pace. A note of gravity — she's acknowledging the seriousness of the subject. Not performative. Genuinely considering what he's uncovered.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦時下の醜い差別表現を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined the ugly discriminatory language that emerged during wartime.
lines.style: Direct and grounded. Slightly harder line than before — he's stating facts, not flinching from them. Small breath between thoughts. Respectful of the material.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 人為的な災害の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And man-made disasters — you tackled that history in your work as well?
lines.style: Energized slightly, nodding as she speaks. Recognition of a pattern emerging. She's impressed by his range. Clear, encouraging tone — watching him make connections.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、市民を援護する諸団体の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I researched the various organizations that emerged to support affected citizens.
lines.style: Steady again, but with a subtle lift. This answer feels more hopeful than the previous ones. He's found something constructive to hold. Voice opens slightly at the end.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、邪悪と評された人物史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Figures throughout history condemned as evil — that was another focus of yours?
lines.style: Contemplative, almost knowing. She's connecting the thread. Measured delivery. A slight pause before his name, like she's carefully framing the question. Respectful distance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、近代の監獄制度を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I looked closely at modern prison systems and their development.
lines.style: Calm closing. A sense of settling into place. Voice finds its ground. Not rushed. Quiet certainty. The statement lands as completion, not deflection.
